title: Austin: Bonds Burned, Service Cars Approved
summary:
*   Officials publicly destroyed financial bonds in the City Hall furnace as part of an accountability measure.
*   A new "service car" operation was approved, indicating the city's early regulation of taxi-like services, and refunds were issued for overpaid service car licenses.
*   Requests for fine remissions were heard, including one for failing jury duty, and some refunds for animal pound fees were issued to citizens.

RECESSED SESSION OF THE CITY COUNCIL:

Austin, Texas, October 31, 1919.
Roll call showed the following members present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Haynes and
Ward; absent Councilman Graham.
The following certificate, presented by Councilman Haynes , was read and action taken
thereon and the bonds mentioned therein were burned in the furnace at the City Hall in the
presence of the Mayor and City Council and the certificate was duly signed by each of
them:
